codex_scope.policy: Retain stable IDs and URLs. Align educational depth, prerequisites, reproducible exercises, failure/recovery, sources and navigation; do not inflate counts or invent product parity.

current_acceptance_expectations: Every lesson identifies the exact starting files or complete inline input, expected output, failure case and stopping/reset procedure.
A downloadable file must match its source and remain reproducible across text line endings; an archive is not proof of a real product operation.
Separate content/schema checks, local exercise checks, real Codex operations, final browser checks and publication.
Keep five-language inputs and code consistent, with native product limitations explicitly preserved.

Claude-specific Hooks and Agent Teams interfaces
limits: This is a curriculum comparison, not a new editorial checkpoint or a declaration that pending Codex lessons passed.
